query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
facility as "Facility",
department as "Department",
requesting_department as "Requesting department",
concat_ws(', ', location_group, location) as "Location",
lab_request_id as "Request ID",
status as "Status",
lab_test_panel as "Lab test panel",
lab_test_category as "Test category",
to_char(((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Lab request date and time",
requested_by as "Requesting clinician",
to_char(((lab_request_published_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Lab request published date and time",
to_char(lab_test_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Lab test date",
result as "Result",
verification as "Verification",
lab_test_type as "Lab test type",
to_char(((lab_test_completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Lab test completed date and time"
from "reporting"."ds__lab_tests"
where ((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:statusId is null then true
else status_id = 
:statusId
end
and
case
when 
:testCategoryId is null then true
else lab_test_category_id = 
:testCategoryId
end
order by
requested_datetime,
lab_test_panel,
lab_request_published_datetime,
lab_test_completed_datetime,
lab_test_type
name: Lab tests line list
notes: This report generates a list of all patients that have had a lab test created. Patients are listed in chronological order based on the lab request date and time.
